# ctables/shr

> Arithmetic shift right: `>>`, keeping the sign.

truck [ctables](../ctables.md) · [source](../../../registry/ctables/shr.pkg) · translates [std/shr](../std/shr.md)

  The count is taken modulo 64, like the x86 `sar` instruction.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
@binop
{L.a} >> ({L.b} & 63); })
```

Includes: [ctables/binop](binop.md)
